values.note: Village of Soldiers Grove: electric sites $25, non-electric sites $23, tents $12. Passes from the Village Office (weekdays 7:30-4) or Campbell's One Stop (Mobil).

fees.source: https://soldiersgrove.municipalimpact.com/beauford-t-anderson-campground ('Electric sites: $25.00, Non-electric sites: $23.00, and tents: $12.00'; 'Camping passes can be purchased at the Village Office Monday-Friday 7:30 am to 4:00 pm or at Campbell's One Stop(Mobil).'), read 2026-11-16

hookups.source: https://soldiersgrove.municipalimpact.com/beauford-t-anderson-campground ('We offer 35 electric and water camp sites'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: 35 electric-and-water sites plus non-electric sites; tents may set up anywhere in the park. One camping unit and two vehicles a site.

sites.source: https://soldiersgrove.municipalimpact.com/beauford-t-anderson-campground ('35 electric and water camp sites'; 'Tents can be set up anywhere in the park.'; § 82-2 C-D), read 2026-11-16

facilities.source: https://soldiersgrove.municipalimpact.com/beauford-t-anderson-campground ('a dump station'; 'We now offer WIFI to all campers.'; 'men's and women's bathrooms with showers available to campers'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Water and bathrooms close for the winter (closed by November 2026), but camping is still allowed then, with electricity on.

season.source: https://soldiersgrove.municipalimpact.com/beauford-t-anderson-campground ('THE CAMPGROUND WATER HAS BEEN TURNED OFF AND BATHROOMS ARE CLOSED FOR THE 2026 SEASON. CAMPING IS STILL ALLOWED BUT THERE IS NO AVAILABLE WATER. ELECTRICITY IS STILL ON.'), read 2026-11-16; clears the note-derived year_round:false, which the page contradicts and does not replace

values.note: First-come; buy the pass before setting up. No more than 7 days in any 14, then out for 7 days.

booking.source: https://soldiersgrove.municipalimpact.com/beauford-t-anderson-campground ('Camping is first come first serve, we do not take reservations.'; § 82-2 B 'no camping unit shall remain for a period greater than seven days in any fourteen day period'), read 2026-11-16

note: Village of Soldiers Grove campground in Beauford T. Anderson Park, in town beside the Kickapoo River (Crawford County). --Claude
summary: Village page read: base $23 non-electric, $25 electric (low was 25 -> 23), 35 electric+water sites plus non-electric and tents, showers, dump, WiFi, first-come only (confirmed), 7-night limit in 14 (new). Season: page says camping continues after water/bathrooms close, so the note-derived year_round:false is cleared. Not waterfront kept. Amps and site lengths not stated.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The park sits in a bend of the Kickapoo River (river ~40-60 m from the park's west and south edges on Esri imagery), but no page shows where the 35 sites are and imagery doesn't resolve pads, so nothing earns a river value.
